description: This file defines a User controller class with methods for managing user data, including retrieval, creation, updating, deletion, and password change, using a Mongoose model and bcrypt for password hashing.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Controller class for user-related operations such as fetching, adding, editing, deleting users, and changing passwords.

methods.name: getAllUser
methods.description: Fetches all users with populated product and user info, sorted by ID descending.

methods.name: getSingleUser
methods.description: Retrieves a single user by ID with specific fields.

methods.name: postAddUser
methods.description: Creates a new user record with provided details.

methods.name: postEditUser
methods.description: Updates an existing user's name and phone number.

methods.name: getDeleteUser
methods.description: Updates the status of a user (soft delete or status change).

methods.name: changePassword
methods.description: Changes a user's password after verifying the old password.
